Jessica

Meeting Jessica was a true revolution in my relationship with my beloved "pack mate."
I had "educated" Ivarr according to the classic command/obedience systems.
He was a true soldier, responding to every command perfectly.
Unfortunately, however, he had assumed a role, from the beginning, that didn't suit him:
That of protecting me when we passed another dog on the street, or even when he smelled it, and he transformed into a beast.
This role had led to anxiety and stress that made every walk truly unpleasant.
Only when he was off-leash in a suitable area did he play with all the dogs, because he actually has a greedy/playful nature.

I embarked on this journey with Jessica because I was very sorry that this cheerful and joyful furry friend was having a hard time walking with me, and I with him.
The concept I've begun to internalize through the journey with J is that we are a pack; I need to understand what he's communicating to me with his body, his gaze, and his voice. And I'm also learning to make myself understood with a "canine" language, made of gestures, movements, or touches that aren't commands but dialogue.
The change is wonderful. I love walking with him because, even if it's not an immediate change—considering that's how we've structured ourselves over nine years of living together—we're slowly understanding each other. I'm learning how to make him understand that he shouldn't take on roles that aren't his—pack leader, for example—and above all, he needs to regain confidence in himself and his autonomy.

It's a wonderful journey; it's also allowed me to rediscover the ability to sleep or lie on the same sofa (something I avoided in an effort to make him understand that I was in charge and he was subordinate) without each losing our place, meaning we're together.
I feel like I've undergone a psychological journey through myself, while trying to look at him.
I would recommend anyone who has decided to live with a furry friend to explore this experience and learn from a different perspective how to relate to your best friend with your heart, not with human logic.

Thank you, Jessica, with love, Maria Fanciulli

A year ago, I fostered a four-year-old Akita with several behavioral issues: he was aggressive, biting, and constantly under a lot of stress.

I turned to Jessica and immediately realized it was a truly excellent choice. From the beginning, she was clear and honest, not selling easy solutions or instant results, but explaining to me clearly what the process would be.

What I appreciated most was that she never "corrected" the dog in the traditional sense of the word. She worked on me, teaching me to truly understand him: she explained precisely the reasons behind his behaviors and gave me the tools to anticipate his reactions and intervene in a way that he could understand, always respecting his experiences and for his own good.

The changes came immediately: every suggestion proved concrete and beneficial. The process was fair, targeted, and without unnecessary delays.

Today, the dog is completely calm, manageable, and balanced, and we have built an excellent relationship.

I am sincerely grateful for the work done and I would recommend it to anyone who has to deal with similar situations, but also to those who simply have a dog that is a little more nervous or unruly than usual.

Beautiful place, very large and perfectly organized for every need of our four-legged friends.
My Rudi tried it for the first time today and had a great time. He played a lot with two new friends, Belle and Olivia.
I will use Social Dog Lab to take him at least once a week to socialize and have fun. It was a pleasure to see them so happy. Thank you, thank you ❤️
Expertise, attention to detail, and excellent problem-solving skills. Jessica has a thorough and detailed understanding of dogs. Highly recommended!

I highly recommend this organization to anyone who wants to give their dog hours of fun and socialization. Alessio and Jessica are reliable, competent, and passionate about what they do, and my dog, Niccolò, always comes away happy. Highly recommended.

I met Jessica from Social Dog Lab at the recommendation of my vet, and I'm so glad I did. From the first meeting, I realized her approach is completely different from the usual methods. She's able to read dog behaviors and explain them to you so you can understand them and, above all, understand your dog. In just a few sessions, she's helping me understand how to interact with Molly and resolve my issues. Already after the first meeting, I've seen her much calmer, and you can tell she's starting to trust me more and more. The change has been truly amazing in such a short time, and seeing Molly more serene and calm makes me feel calmer and happier too. Thank you so much!

I've known Alessio for a long time, and when I heard he'd opened a full-service dog welfare facility, I didn't hesitate to entrust him with Johnny, a setter with significant behavioral issues due to his difficult past. I'd had several unsuccessful experiences, but the synergy between Alessio and Jessica, combined with their in-depth expertise, allowed me to fully understand what I needed to work on to allow Johnny to live a more peaceful life with me and his fellow dogs. After a month, I'm already seeing significant results!

I've been attending the center for over a month now for behavioral rehabilitation for my 4-year-old dog.
I'd been "studying" Jessica from afar for days before scheduling my first consultation, almost terrified by the thought of running into yet another dog lover I'd run away from within seconds. I've read her website countless times, as well as everything she's shared on social media over time: the more I read, the more fascinated I became by her method and approach.
Over these four years, I've met with several professionals, but without ever really being able to get started; something was always missing, especially trust and confidence.
Jessica, on the other hand, impressed me from the very first moment. She's extremely knowledgeable, and there's nothing pre-packaged about her. The lessons aren't based on treats or commands; each session is tailor-made, based on the specific issue we're facing.
There's no set schedule, and that's precisely what I appreciate most. She gets to the heart of the problem in no time, is crystal clear in her explanations, and provides concrete tools, never leaving you in doubt. The well-being of the dog and the owner always comes first.
And then, behind this great professional, there's a wonderful person, deeply empathetic, sweet, capable of always making you feel welcomed. In that hour with her, you never feel alone, never judged, never misunderstood.
Jessica never neglects our emotional and psychological state, and this is a quality that is far from taken for granted.
Thank you so much for everything. The small but actually enormous steps I'm taking with Nina are only thanks to you. You've found the right key, both for me and for her.
My only regret? Not having met you sooner.

Even though I'm new to the experience, I've had a great time with Jessica and Social Dog Lab.
The progress is already remarkable (even though, I repeat, we've only just started 😊), and I'm learning a lot about my dog ​​and how to best care for him. Jessica is very professional and knows how to work well even with dogs like mine (a medium-large, senior dog who recently joined us). You can tell she really cares about the animals and what she does, taking special care and attention. She's a very honest and fair person.
I highly recommend her; I'm really enjoying it!

Hi, I'm Giorgia. It's been 7 months since I lost my 15-year-old Nena (my soulmate, an unbearable pain). So in September I decided to save another furry friend, but after the adoption, a thousand uncertainties, fears, doubts began. I didn't know where to start, and above all, how to empathize with the puppy! With the support of friends who recommended Social Dog Lab, I decided to embark on an educational and social journey for him. I entered the process slowly, with a thousand fragilities and insecurities!
Jessica and Alessio... their dedication, skill, professionalism, and their reassuring words helped me understand and empathize with my Alfred's world!!! Social Dog Lab is surrounded by greenery, with well-kept and well-organized fields, where you can find friendly four-legged friends for Alfred. He runs to get in and never wants to leave.
Thank you guys 🙏

After 12 years of boundless love with our Frida, we've decided to continue opening our hearts, and to start over, we've embarked on a new adventure: adopting two adult dogs.
Jaco and Lucy have been with us for a year and a half, and everything has been wonderful, but often chaotic, discouraging, and difficult to manage. So we decided to let ourselves be guided, because we need to listen and seek help from those who know "something"! In Alessio and Jessica, we've found empathy and a listening ear, and between daycare and the educational program—as well as mutual behavioral rehabilitation—we finally feel like we're connecting with our beloved setter!
Your advice is invaluable, and we'll treasure it forever! We know it's a long road, but we've connected, we understand each other... and it's wonderful... Thank you guys, you're amazing 😊

Jessica is the best and most knowledgeable ethologist trainer you could ever meet. I've met several training experts, but she's the absolute best, a true scientist who dedicates her life to understanding dog behavior and relationships. Every interaction with her can only enrich me; I consider myself fortunate to have had the opportunity to listen to her advice.

A valuable canine workshop where dogs and people learn to know and respect each other thanks to the professionalism of teachers Jessica and Alessio. Thank you for your expertise and knowledge. Jessica and Alessio are the two dog trainers who founded this superb school. Here I learned to communicate with my puppy. Love for animals and respect for their nature reigns supreme here. Thank you for your precious, authentic teachings.

Jessica and Alessio are two reliable and serious professionals. We've seen great improvements with our puppy. I highly recommend this school.
Thank you so much for your work.

I discovered Social Dog Lab through word of mouth, and I can say it was one of the best choices for Olimpia. They are Jessica and Alessio, two people who put their heart and soul into what they do.

It all started with Jessica, because Olimpia needed behavioral therapy: she had started growling at guests at home, and we didn't understand why. I thought it was just a problem that needed "fixing," but with them, I discovered that the real work was understanding her. They taught me how to communicate with her, how to help her, and how to make her feel that I would always protect her. This program has changed me profoundly, because it doesn't just work on the dog, but also on yourself.

Jessica is an empathetic and attentive person. Every word has weight and is born from a love for her work. A quote that touched me is:

"The dog's feeling in a given moment is the same feeling it makes you feel in that same moment."
It captures all the magic of the bond between dog and human.

Alessio is Olimpia's "uncle." He sees her three times a week with incredible dedication: he observes, understands, and works with her with genuine passion. He's honest, direct, and sincere—even when the truth can hurt—and this makes him precious. I still remember when, in a moment of exhaustion, I tried a more "hard" approach. He looked at me and, with all his frankness, said, "You're screwing up." And he was right: he said it not out of self-interest, but out of love.

Today Olimpia has changed. She sleeps peacefully, trusts more, and truly communicates. At the nursery, she's become a wild card, able to adapt and play with everyone. We've redefined rules, spaces, and routines, and every little bit of progress is an immense joy.

I don't want to write a "sappy" review, but a truthful one. The journey is long: when you improve something, another often emerges that needs fixing. You work hard, but you also achieve a lot. And that "a lot" is an immense joy.

Thank you so much, Jessica and Alessio, for teaching me that true education isn't about control, but about connection. Today Olimpia and I have more balance, trust, and mutual love. ❤️

Jessica and Alessio are experienced teachers in training and understanding dog language. They bring humanity, sensitivity, dedication, and care to their work. The overall evaluation is absolutely positive.

We adopted our dog Birillo—a 10-month-old fawn mixed breed—from a shelter last February, after he had been abandoned at the public shelter by his previous owner just a month earlier. From what the shelter staff had told us, the dog was docile and had always lived indoors, and during our repeated meetings at the shelter prior to adoption, we had never seen anything to the contrary.

In reality, things were a little different. Birillo is a very curious dog, yet profoundly anxious and fearful, and he addresses these limitations with inconsistent and unmotivated aggression toward new people. But the worst aspect was his socialization: Birillo lacked it completely. Walks were traumatic, a sort of "water skiing" through the streets, from which we returned home exhausted, both dog and owner; not to mention the encounters with all the other dogs on walks: an unspeakable ordeal. The first sessions with other trainers proved completely unsuccessful, and we were genuinely disheartened because Birillo seemed beyond help; we felt helpless. We admit that the idea of ​​returning him to the shelter—even though we would never have done it—had crossed our minds several times.

In our search for a solution, we discovered the Social Dog Lab school online, and it was a turning point. We began the sessions at the end of May, and right away, thanks to the teachings, advice, and work of the two trainers, Jessica and Alessio, Birillo is making remarkable progress, both educationally and socially. We're only at the beginning, and the journey will still be long, but we're definitely on the right track.

A few words for Jessica and Alessio: there are aspects that characterize professionals, including a deep knowledge of their profession, the dedication with which they apply themselves, the passion with which they live, the attention to detail, and the empathy with which they relate to others. Well, Jessica and Alessio have all these qualities, they are two serious professionals to whom we extend our most sincere thanks for the fundamental help they are giving us with our Birillo.

Highly recommended! Alessio and Jessica are two passionate and talented dog lovers. They succeed where many would give up! The facility is well-maintained and safe. Our four-legged friends have fun and learn to relate to each other through playing and running. Try it!

I discovered the Social Dog Lab school through Facebook as I was looking for a dog trainer for my 3-year-old four-legged friend who suffers from separation anxiety. After speaking with several trainers and always receiving negative responses, partly due to the breed's unique characteristics (Czechoslovakian wolfdog), I decided to seek further evaluation from this school. Trainers Jessica Orobello and Alessio De Grecis immediately proved to be very professional, empathetic, and attentive to the dog's well-being. It's certainly a long journey, but after about two months, thanks to the advice and work done with the support of Jessica and Alessio, the little wolf cub is much calmer and more sociable in his daily life, and is able to manage his anxiety and emotions much better, even occasionally staying home alone or at daycare.
What can I say?! An absolutely positive experience!!
I recommend the center to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friend, both in terms of socialization and training.
Thank you for your availability and the help you are giving us to overcome this challenge. 😃🐺

Thanks to the work I'm doing with Social Dog Lab, especially with trainer Jessica, I've noticed significant behavioral improvements in my nine-year-old dog Pupa. By putting into practice what Jessica is teaching me, I can more easily manage Pupa around other dogs. Ciro

An extraordinary experience, Jessica Orobello is helping me tremendously at home to train and correct mistakes made due to inexperience with my poodle Cesare, who is stubborn, shy, and insecure. She's introducing me to a world of relationships that I never imagined would be so rich in interpretations of Cesare's every communication or behavior. The results I'm achieving in caring for him are already remarkable. Now he's also starting his journey at the daycare center, where there are large, immaculately kept spaces and perfect organization. Here, Alessio, with his "army" of furry friends, along with Jessica, also help improve socialization and relationships between the different dogs present, thus allowing me to have better and more peaceful outings. They are two competent and wonderful people, who love their work and work miracles with us owners. It was a great fortune to find them and get to know them. Thank you ❤️
Thanks to Jessica for her invaluable help in socializing and building the bond between our elderly daughter and our feisty new puppy. Malù and Skeggia thank you...and so do we! ❤️

Jessica and Alessio, if I could give you ten stars, I would. My journey with you began to ease Olivia's hypersensitivity as an adult and to tone down little Sara's excessive energy... to help them live together and share... In the end, the journey was my own... I learned to observe in silence... To respect both of our times... to intervene when necessary... to see them slowly open up at nursery... To become more confident on their own... with me... And above all with me... It's not enough to give them a home if it doesn't feel like one... I wasn't looking for obedience, I was looking for serenity, and Alessio and Jessica are teaching me where to look... 😍

I'm following a program with my dog ​​Kira. She had some insecurity issues; she was often fearful and suspicious of both other dogs and people... now, after just the first few sessions, I'm already noticing improvements!
Jessica was super helpful and gave me exercises to do at home that are really making a difference.
Kira is more relaxed, and I feel more confident in caring for her. We haven't finished the program yet, but I'm already very happy!
They also have many other activities at the center that I can't wait to try with Kira 😊
A thousand thanks!
Excellent experience, excellent professionals and excellent educators of both our dogs and us owners 😊 …
Beautiful structure, well maintained and cared for.. Alessio and Jessica two fantastic people.... the best for us and our puppies!

Jessica Orobello is a truly special trainer.
Anyone who knows Shiba Inus knows how intense, independent, and often misunderstood they can be. It's not uncommon for them to be considered "difficult" or "impossible to manage," but with her, that was never the case. From our first meeting, she approached Yuki with gentleness and respect, observing in silence, with that attentive calm that captures what often escapes. But perhaps what I appreciated most was that she didn't just help him: she also understood me. She listened to me, with empathy and without judgment, guiding me with small gestures and sincere advice that made all the difference. It's rare to feel supported in such an authentic way.
I met her thanks to a recommendation from the groomer, and I was genuinely surprised to see how much her interventions transformed our daily lives, without ever compromising the bond that unites us. In the past, some trainers, faced with this breed—often described as "primitive"—made it seem like there wasn't much they could do. With Jessica, however, there was never any hesitation. She never backed down. She always demonstrated patience, availability, and deep commitment, even supporting us at home with great dedication and expertise.

Her support gave me concrete tools, but also the peace of mind and confidence to face each day with serenity, without ever distorting the relationship I have with Yuki or his nature. For all of this, I am deeply grateful.
I recommend Jessica to anyone looking for a trainer capable of combining knowledge and heart, and of respectfully accompanying them every step of the journey they share with their dog.

A magical place for our dogs, who are treated with respect, love, discipline, and great professionalism... just looking into their eyes is enough to understand that they are loved and cared for by expert hands that help us raise them in harmony, placing value on proper socialization and a perfect balance of character.

She's a Golden; she should be calm; but instead, she's a FORCE OF NATURE. That's what Jessica called her the first time she met her. On the one hand, we liked the definition, on the other, we understood it would be challenging, more so than with the previous Golden, who was just a decorative ornament. With Jessica, it was truly a wonderful adventure. She introduced us to a new world: hers, but also that of our furry friends. She overturned all the beliefs that most of us have been instilled in us. To give just a few small examples, the constant sitting or the constant treats. Everything was revolutionized, but she explained why, making us understand the meaning of things and their language. In reality, Jessica educated us and, as a result, helped us build a relationship with Ohana. The phrase that convinced us to continue with her was: "I just want the dog to be free of anxiety." I could write so much, but I'll limit myself to advising you to try this wonderful adventure of discovery.
Then we also started taking her to daycare, which isn't just a parking lot where they can just hang out. Alessio helps them socialize, rotating different groups of dogs to help them develop different skills and relationships, which tire them out, not just physically. And above all, they grow.
I believe Jessica, Alessio, and their center, meticulously cared for and eager to grow and offer more initiatives, are a valuable asset for our furry friends. Above all, they offer the highest quality because you can see and feel that it's not just a business, but one filled with passion, love, and professionalism.

Meeting Jessica was an unexpected surprise. After so much suffering and sadness, she immediately understood me and my little furry friend. He was difficult, scared, and protective, and so was I. I never imagined that you could get to know and improve your relationship with your pet by talking. And the small progress is noticeable! Thank you.

My experience with Social Dog Lab has been absolutely extraordinary. The two trainers, Jessica Orobello and Alessio De Grecis, immediately demonstrated great professionalism and empathy toward me and my puppy. I was looking for competent experts to help me introduce my dog ​​to dog training while respecting his nature. Thanks to Jessica and Alessio, I began to understand my dog ​​better, to give him what he needs, and now he is happy and carefree. The initial behaviors of the first few days, stemming from stress, insecurity, and trauma (due to being abandoned), have gradually disappeared. Thanks to the socialization with other dogs, provided by the school through the daycare, I offer him a better quality of life. I recommend this school to anyone who wants the best for their four-legged friends; learning to understand them helps us love them better.

We did a short and very useful training session with Jessica before getting our female English bulldog puppy, so we could immediately learn how to best behave after she arrived home.

Jessica then took some lessons with the dog, which proved to be very useful 🐶

Jessica made a great impression on me right away; she's a very attentive and meticulous professional.

Rating: 10

Results were already visible after the first sessions. At the same time, we started attending daycare with Alessio De Grecis for proper socialization with other dogs outside the home and to help Diego feel more confident and less fearful on various fronts. He is always ready to give us lots of advice. Diego is improving steadily, and we are very satisfied for both him and us. I recommend them!

Five stars probably aren't enough to express my satisfaction and appreciation for their approach, which focuses on every detail to resolve and/or correct issues that can arise within the dog or between dog and owner. I personally took a course with Jessica, and both my dog ​​and I experienced enormous benefits, both individually and in our interaction. I can only highly recommend them and speak highly of them, based on the results!
We know "Social Dog Lab" and are extremely satisfied with the service they provided for our dog. They are animal lovers and take truly comprehensive care of them!

Since we took Thay to daycare, he's finally socialized with other dogs and never wants to go home. Thanks to Alessio for this success, which complements Jessica's tremendous work as a behavioral trainer and has allowed our furry friend to improve day after day! I highly recommend this dog training center for their expertise, professionalism, and great empathy!
By going to the guys at Social Dog Lab, we resolved much of our Rambo's intense emotional state. They taught us how to understand and interpret his behavior. Highly recommended 👍🏻 …

It took me a while to write my review because I was thinking about all the wonderful things I could write about and couldn't prioritize them. The first thing I can say is that this journey, even if it's currently interrupted, I feel it every day, still present. I find it in everything we've learned and do, I find it in my thoughts and memories. I received advice on the type of bed she would have liked (she climbed on the couch, disdaining her own) and where in the house to put it. I also received advice on which chew toys are best for her, whether we think they affect her sleep and relaxation, and her need to be part of the family, without always overdoing her control, given her nature as a herd guard dog. Jessica is a wonderful person to whom I owe the love I have for my dog, whom I just didn't understand. She was a beautiful, demanding, herding, emotional, and large dog. She had the problem of being overly attentive to the world around her, with extreme distrust, aggression, and arousal. She drooled constantly, and I didn't understand that it was stress and not food cravings. In fact, I showered her with treats, which only made the situation worse... thinking back! I called Jessica in alarm
because I couldn't leave the house without something very unpleasant happening with people, and I thought I wouldn't be able to keep her, conflicted by the duty I felt toward my young children, who adored her, and my own life, which had become stressful. A journey that focused on the living being of the dog and the relationship with the human who takes him in, to create a true bond, to be credible, to be trustworthy. So the problems gradually decreased in intensity and frequency, my newly learned management skills made me feel more and more confident, and the process was very natural, even if tiring, demanding, and constant. I took home what I understood and learned, and I still put it into practice every day; it's a part of me now. Now she can run free in the fields on occasion, when I understand she's keeping her excitement under control (besides the dog parks, which she only enjoys for the first 5 minutes). We'll resume the process to generalize this, because Jessica tells me she can be reached, she lets strangers into the house without displaying aggressive behavior or what appears to be aggressive, she's no longer a problem on the street with either dogs or people, she lets herself be groomed without despair, she goes to boarding for several days and nights with dogs of all kinds, all loose and she minds "her own business" peacefully. They describe her as a dog who is always well-liked and who doesn't need special attention because she's calm and competent with everyone, we understand each other perfectly. I did this with my husband, so we shared the experience; he learned as I did, and now we're both perfectly independent. My children are small now, but they'll be able to take her out soon. We are happy to have met Jessica on our life journey, because now it is a harmonious and peaceful life, and I always thank her for the clarity with which she helped us discover a new world and for having made her immense experience in observing dog behavior available to us, because only by understanding others can we come together. Thank you, Jessica.
